WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> ''
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT "first_name", COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY "first_name"
    ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT an."first_name", an."district"
FROM admin_names an
JOIN name_counts nc ON an."first_name" = nc."first_name"
GROUP BY an."first_name", an."district"
ORDER BY an."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, an."district" ASC NULLS FIRST;

49:
WITH closed_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        s."school",
        s."closeddate"
    FROM "schools" s
    WHERE s."statustype" LIKE '%Closed%'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cs."county",
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM closed_schools cs
    GROUP BY cs."county"
),
top_county AS (
    SELECT cc."county"
    FROM county_counts cc
    ORDER BY cc.cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    cs."school",
    cs."closeddate"
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_county tc ON cs."county" = tc."county"
ORDER BY cs."closeddate" ASC NULLS FIRST;

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_difference
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT s.school, s.doctype
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > a.avg_difference
ORDER BY s.school ASC NULLS FIRST;

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT ss."cds"
    FROM "satscores" ss
    ORDER BY ss."numge1500" DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    s."admfname1" AS "first_name",
    s."admlname1" AS "last_name"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN top_school ts ON s."cdscode" = ts."cds"
WHERE s."admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND s."admlname1" IS NOT NULL

UNION

SELECT
    s."admfname2" AS "first_name",
    s."admlname2" AS "last_name"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN top_school ts ON s."cdscode" = ts."cds"
WHERE s."admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND s."admlname2" IS NOT NULL

UNION

SELECT
    s."admfname3" AS "first_name",
    s."admlname3" AS "last_name"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN top_school ts ON s."cdscode" = ts."cds"
WHERE s."admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND s."admlname3" IS NOT NULL;
